summary: Clearwater NF lookout in Idaho County, reportedly built 1934 and abandoned by 1940; one source says destroyed 1972; no source says it stands today.

facts.status_note: No source says the tower stands today. firelookout.com reports it destroyed in 1972; the register says concrete piers may still exist at the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives a 30-foot pole; firelookout.com gives 40 feet. No height is recorded in facts; the story reports both figures.
Register and firelookout.com describe an L-4 tower or cab; Idaho Fire Lookouts calls the 1930s structure a log cabin. The story reports both.
Register says abandoned by 1940 and still standing in 1950; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1972. The end date is unresolved and the story says so.

sources.title: Round Top Mountain (entry quoting The Missoulian, April 4, 1934)

notes_for_editor: Identity: the Clearwater NF site (46.5338, -114.5916; 6,555 ft per register; 6560 ft per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts) matches the brief. A search snippet pointed to a different Round Top Mountain lookout in the north Idaho panhandle (1935 pole tower, destroyed 1961) and to a separate 'Roundtop Mtn' page on firelookout.com; neither was used. Date and height disagree across sources; no ground photo or recent source found. No photos added: the credited Montana Memory Project and Bud Moore images have no stated license in the pages read. Brief record 'status gone' is consistent with the sources; no corrections proposed.
